title: múlt hétvégén and Talking About Groups

sections.title: Last weekend, built the same way as last week
sections.content: You already know múlt héten ("last week") from Unit 2. hétvégén works exactly the same way with múlt in front of it: múlt hétvégén, "last weekend". When you name two people together with és ("and"), the verb has to be 3rd person plural, even though each person alone would just be "he" or "she" — Károly és Ildikó piknikeztek, not piknikezett.

items.spanish: Reggel kirándultunk, aztán piknikeztünk a parkban.
items.english: We hiked in the morning, then had a picnic in the park.
The last time they did sport together was last year.

sections.content: mindketten ("both of them") is a handy shortcut when two people did the same thing, so you don't have to repeat both names: Mindketten kirándultak ("Both of them hiked") says the same thing as Károly és Ildikó kirándultak, just shorter.
